note: Proficiency levels reflect studio experience and craft depth across brand identity, editorial design, and print production.

groups.title: Brand & Visual Identity
groups.description: Comprehensive identity systems: distinctive logomarks, typography hierarchies, color theory, and modular brand architectures.

groups.title: Editorial & Typography
groups.description: Editorial craft rooted in Swiss modernist grid traditions, meticulous typesetting, and publication layout.

groups.title: Packaging & Physical Media
groups.description: Tactile packaging, dieline drafting, sustainable substrate selection, and structural unboxing design.

groups.title: Print Production & Prepress
groups.description: Rigorous prepress engineering, spot color separation, paper stock curation, and bindery craft.

groups.title: Digital Direction & Systems
groups.description: Bringing graphic sensibility into digital interfaces, responsive design systems, and design tokens.

groups.title: Creative Direction & Art Craft
groups.description: Conceptual direction, image making, photo shoot supervision, and poster art.

principles.title: Typography carries the soul
principles.text: Every typographic choice conveys meaning before a single sentence is read. Hierarchy, proportion, and spacing define tone.

principles.title: Honor the physical medium
principles.text: Ink on cotton paper, blind debossing, and foil are tactile conversations. Design with the natural qualities of the material in mind.

principles.title: Clarity over ornamentation
principles.text: A thoughtful grid and deliberate white space communicate with greater resonance than arbitrary decorative clutter.

principles.title: Systems that scale gracefully
principles.text: Great brand systems provide consistent structure while granting creative teams the flexibility to express new ideas.
